_comment: Spec-034 FR-018 / FR-019 — required checks on main. This file is descriptive only (GitHub does not consume it directly); apply via Repo Settings → Branches → Branch protection rules. Each entry is the GitHub Actions job-name string that must report success before a PR can merge.
rationale: T154 — the gate-job is the binary capstone-readiness check; without all 4 shards + merge succeeding, the gate cannot evaluate the trace, so all are required.
